note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Screens that mix a terminal and a portal carry the second half in also[] (when = before/after the main part). Scenes read MG_LAB_ADMIN_UPN / MG_LAB_DOMAIN (set by prepare, derived from the signed-in labadmin).
prepare: if (-not (Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name Microsoft.Graph.Authentication)) { Install-Module Microsoft.Graph.Authentication -Scope CurrentUser -Force -AllowClobber }

Connect-MgGraph -Scopes RoleAssignmentSchedule.ReadWrite.Directory, RoleEligibilitySchedule.ReadWrite.Directory, RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory, AccessReview.ReadWrite.All, LifecycleWorkflows-Workflow.ReadWrite.All, LifecycleWorkflows-Workflow.Activate, User.ReadWrite.All, GroupMember.ReadWrite.All, Group.ReadWrite.All, Organization.Read.All, Directory.Read.All -NoWelcome  # owner signs in (browser)
function Set-LabVar($n, $v) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($n, "$v", 'User'); Set-Item "env:$n" "$v" }
$upn = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri /v1.0/me).userPrincipalName; Set-LabVar MG_LAB_ADMIN_UPN $upn; Set-LabVar MG_LAB_DOMAIN $upn.Split('@')[1]
function Get-LabUserId($n) { (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/users/$n@$env:MG_LAB_DOMAIN").id }
$alex = Get-LabUserId 'alex.demo'; Set-LabVar MG_ALEX_ID $alex
# throwaway leaver Sam Leaver (Sales) with E5 + Entra ID Governance licences; never a shared lab user
$sam = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/users?`$filter=userPrincipalName eq 'sam.leaver@$env:MG_LAB_DOMAIN'").value | Select-Object -First 1

if (-not $sam) { $sec = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + 'aA1!'; $sam = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri /v1.0/users -Body ("{`"accountEnabled`":true,`"displayName`":`"Sam Leaver`",`"mailNickname`":`"sam.leaver`",`"userPrincipalName`":`"sam.leaver@$env:MG_LAB_DOMAIN`",`"department`":`"Sales`",`"usageLocation`":`"PT`",`"passwordProfile`":{`"forceChangePasswordNextSignIn`":false,`"password`":`"$sec`"}}"); $sec = $null }; Set-LabVar MG_SAM_ID $sam.id

$skus = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri /v1.0/subscribedSkus).value; $add = @($skus | Where-Object skuPartNumber -in 'SPE_E5', 'Microsoft_Entra_ID_Governance' | ForEach-Object { @{ skuId = $_.skuId; disabledPlans = @() } }); Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri "/v1.0/users/$($sam.id)/assignLicense" -Body @{ addLicenses = $add; removeLicenses = @() } | Out-Null
# group Sales Pipeline Review, Sam sole owner

$pg = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=displayName eq 'Sales Pipeline Review'").value | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $pg) { $pg = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri /v1.0/groups -Body @{ displayName = 'Sales Pipeline Review'; mailNickname = 'salespipelinereview'; mailEnabled = $true; securityEnabled = $false; groupTypes = @('Unified'); 'owners@odata.bind' = @("https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/$($sam.id)") } }; Set-LabVar MG_PIPELINE_GROUP $pg.id
# time-bound ACTIVE Groups Administrator for Sam (7 days) through PIM

$ga = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleDefinitions?`$filter=displayName eq 'Groups Administrator'").value[0].id; Set-LabVar MG_GRPADM_ROLE $ga; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri /v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignmentScheduleRequests -Body @{ action = 'adminAssign'; principalId = $sam.id; roleDefinitionId = $ga; directoryScopeId = '/'; justification = 'Episode 4 leaver demo'; scheduleInfo = @{ startDateTime = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'); expiration = @{ type = 'afterDuration'; duration = 'P7D' } } } | Out-Null
# local policy copy: Alex eligible + fallback reviewer, no emergency access accounts in the lab

$pol = Get-Content ./src/governance.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $pol.emergencyAccessAccountIds = @(); $pol.eligibleAssignments[0].principalId = $alex; $pol.guestReview.fallbackReviewerId = $alex; $pol | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content ./src/governance.lab.json
./src/Invoke-IdentityGovernance.ps1 -Preview   # offline: 'Guest governance add-on needed: no' (never link an Azure subscription on the ID Governance dashboard)

also.account: labadmin, then alex.demo in a second profile
steps: Entra admin center > ID Governance > Privileged Identity Management > Microsoft Entra roles > Assignments > Eligible assignments: Alex Demo, Groups Administrator, end about 180 days out
Second browser profile as alex.demo: PIM > My roles > Eligible assignments > Activate Groups Administrator, type a justification, Activate
Active assignments: show the active assignment and its end time
mask: e-mail addresses beyond the lab aliases

steps: Entra admin center > ID Governance > Access reviews: open 'Quarterly review - guests in Microsoft 365 groups', one instance per group with guests (TEAM_Sales_Partner Portal or Sales Partner Portal)
Second profile as alex.demo: myaccess.microsoft.com > Access reviews > open the review: the guest with Approve / Deny (do NOT submit a decision)
If the instance list is empty, wait and refresh; do not fake it

screens.name: leaver
prepare: Connect-MgGraph -Scopes LifecycleWorkflows-Workflow.ReadWrite.All -NoWelcome
./src/Invoke-IdentityGovernance.ps1 -PolicyFile ./src/governance.lab.json -CreateLeaverWorkflow -Confirm:$false

$wf = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/identityGovernance/lifecycleWorkflows/workflows?`$filter=displayName eq 'Leaver - Sales members on their last day'").value | Select-Object -First 1; [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('MG_LEAVER_WF', $wf.id, 'User'); $env:MG_LEAVER_WF = $wf.id
commands: # Blocked: Sam holds an Entra role and is the sole owner. Remove the role assignment and add Alex as second owner:

Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri /v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignmentScheduleRequests -Body @{ action = 'adminRemove'; principalId = $env:MG_SAM_ID; roleDefinitionId = $env:MG_GRPADM_ROLE; directoryScopeId = '/'; justification = 'Leaver' } | Out-Null

steps: Entra admin center > ID Governance > Lifecycle workflows > the leaver workflow > Workflow history
Show Sam Leaver with the 4 tasks completed

teardown: # Alex's eligible assignment (do this before the Entra ID Governance trial ends on 20 Dec 2026)

foreach ($r in (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleEligibilitySchedules?`$filter=principalId eq '$env:MG_ALEX_ID'").value) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri /v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleEligibilityScheduleRequests -Body @{ action = 'adminRemove'; principalId = $r.principalId; roleDefinitionId = $r.roleDefinitionId; directoryScopeId = $r.directoryScopeId; justification = 'Episode 4 tear-down' } | Out-Null }

foreach ($d in (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/identityGovernance/accessReviews/definitions?`$filter=startswith(displayName,'Quarterly review - guests')").value) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/v1.0/identityGovernance/accessReviews/definitions/$($d.id)" }

Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/v1.0/groups/$env:MG_PIPELINE_GROUP"; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/v1.0/users/$env:MG_SAM_ID"; Start-Sleep -Seconds 20; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/v1.0/directory/deletedItems/$env:MG_SAM_ID"
